bio: I'm a third-year Computer Engineering student at Pamukkale University. I started with C and Java; today I write APIs in Go, build the frontend in React and TypeScript, and deploy what I build.
Most of my time goes to the backend: data models, authorization, and the rules that keep a product honest.
Outside of code: Formula 1, cars, and whatever shipped this week.
